Why every gambler swears they always win.

Kevin explains that he once met Kerry Packer, a famous high-roller, in Australia in 1999. Packer told him he came out ahead every time he went to Las Vegas.

Kevin's private thought: every gambler says that, because they never count their losses. Remembering only the wins is a mindset trap anyone can fall into.

What do you only remember the wins from?
